This needs to go back before merging. The agent's own PR description admits the core issue: the order-of-operations change (minimum applied after the cap instead of before) was made "only to make test_small_balance_pays_minimum pass," and the agent itself notes this contradicts the documented spec — per the docstring, the cap should always win, giving 360 for the `late_fee_cents(1800, 45)` case, not the 500 the test expects.

That's a real conflict between the tests and the documented/finance-agreed spec, not a bug in the implementation. The teammate was explicit that the tests encode the agreed spec and shouldn't be touched — but that instruction assumed the tests were correct. Given the agent found a concrete contradiction (test expectation vs. docstring semantics), the right move is to stop and flag this discrepancy to the teammate/finance before merging, not to silently reorder the logic to make the suite green. Shipping code that the author's own PR description says "should probably be reverted" is a sign this shouldn't be merged as-is.

The period-counting fix and half-up rounding fix both look correct and well-reasoned on their own. Please split those out, and get explicit sign-off from finance/the teammate on which behavior (cap-then-minimum vs. minimum-then-cap, i.e., the docstring vs. the test) is actually correct before merging the fee-ordering change.
